text: EmailAuthenticationForm reuses EmailPasswordForm, selects its authentication template and extends super.captureState() with username. The base still owns password validity, remember-password state, reset and focus. Accepted later code adds selector hooks and authentication-prefixed control IDs with matching label targets; those later hooks are not implementation credited to the original template-only change. These names describe the local form/subclass boundary, not a global underscore, ID-prefix or inheritance rule. Isolated form tests check capture/focus, not the complete dialog accessibility tree. No UI or accessibility test ran.
title: The authentication subview extends password capture through local template and selector hooks
